metadata.GT: source fitted MANO references; unchanged recording-disjoint four-source splits; no test labels
metadata.position_units: metres in noisy-history wrist anchor frame
metadata.sampling: equal source then uniform windows, independent rank RNG, with replacement

config.best_selection_description: Weighted current-restoration loss over five fixed strata; reanchor uses exact current reference as a diagnostic. Clean and legacy stress metrics also reported separately.

corruption_profile.target_policy: All current and future targets remain uncorrupted source reference trajectories
corruption_profile.amplitude_convention: Translation is actual 3D displacement norm in mm; rotation is actual SO(3) geodesic angle in degrees, never per-axis std or noise added to rot6d
corruption_profile.amplitude_sampling: Uniform radius/angle within selected range; isotropic random direction; group rotations composed on SO(3)

temporal_noise.history_current_joint_process: shared continuous noise where case permits; explicit reset at current time in current_reanchors_history
temporal_noise.bounded_rule: Normalize direction after any mixing, then multiply by bounded radius/angle. Do not add multiple full-amplitude errors.
temporal_noise.actual_correlation: Must be measured after direction normalization; latent OU rho is not the final error correlation

quality.oracle_quality: optional separately labeled ablation only; not the default condition

corruption_profile.source_sampling: retain current four-source split and sampling; no new images required
limitations: Not fitted to HaWoR empirical error distribution; all amplitudes and mixture weights are unvalidated starting hypotheses
Five percent strong-case sampling is not a guarantee that only five percent of candidate/model joint errors are large; missing-value hold and rotation/FK coupling can add error
Clean restoration may be copied; future labels and dedicated restoration conditions remain necessary
Architecture-independent input corruption. The legacy sampler and old checkpoints remain unchanged.
corruption_profile.execution_policy: Explicitly selected by a fresh training run; old checkpoints/runs remain preserved

scope: Recorded fixed synthetic validation only; source-fitted MANO references, equal-source macro means. No new model evaluation, no test labels, no real HaWoR or independent sensor accuracy claim.
